description.value: Gateau de Henry is a dessert cafe on Burrard Street run by Henry Shin, a former Korean national representative at the World Pastry Cup and holder of a French National Technician License in pastry. The cafe fuses Korean flavors into classic French pastry techniques, producing an unusual lineup of cakes, macarons, Korean rice bowls, and sandwiches. Touring cyclists will find both sweet and savory options, including vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free choices.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates the OSM record: same address, phone, and business identity. The menu page explicitly labels 'Vegan Vegetarian Gluten-Free' categories and lists a Vegan Chocolate cake, confirming dietary options. The quote/ordering page references pick-up dates and times, confirming takeout. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags for bike-specific amenities such as racks, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi.
concerns: OSM name is 'Gateau de Henry' (no accent); website uses 'Gâteau de Henry' with accent on the first 'a'. Minor typographic discrepancy only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible cafe with a confirmed address, phone, and website. A useful stop for touring cyclists seeking food and drinks on Burrard Street.
